source_name: AJPES / Bizi.si business-register profiles of associations (GIZ, zbornice)
why_relevant: Register-derived profiles of the associations themselves — registered legal representatives, address, employee counts and filing history. Provides an independent, legally-grounded check on who formally represents an association and how big its secretariat is, when the association's own site is silent.

source_name: LinkedIn company pages of Slovenian associations (ZBS, ZNS, ZIT, SZZ, Blockchain Alliance Europe)
why_relevant: Associations announce board elections, committee chairs and their own secretariat vacancies here first; the 'People' tab is the only public view of secretariat headcount and role mix. Highest-velocity channel in this cell.

source_name: Slovenian business media coverage of association elections (Delo, RTV SLO, Siol, N1)
why_relevant: Independent, dated confirmation and context for association board elections that the associations themselves report tersely (e.g. GZS presidency change; RTV SLO and Siol tag pages aggregate by organisation). Useful for resolving ambiguity about effective dates and mandates.

source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — Slovenian national public procurement notice portal
why_relevant: Statutory publication venue under ZJN-3 for all above-threshold contract notices by Slovenian contracting authorities, including state financial bodies (UJP, FURS, Ministrstvo za finance, SID banka, Kapitalska družba). Tenders for payment services, card personalisation, payment gateway support, core banking/IT maintenance and IT staff augmentation reveal headcount plans, insourcing/outsourcing shifts and reorganisations inside public financial bodies that no press release covers.

source_name: e-JN — Informacijski sistem e-Javno naročanje (bid submission system)
why_relevant: The mandatory e-submission system paired with the notice portal; hosts the live list of active procurements and the tender documentation packages. Documentation (razpisna dokumentacija) is where role profiles, required FTE counts, seniority and skill profiles for IT staff-augmentation lots are actually specified — the richest hiring/organisation signal in the public-sector route.

source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU procurement journal), Slovenia filter
source_subtype: supranational procurement journal with open API
why_relevant: All Slovenian above-EU-threshold contracts must also appear on TED, with structured English summaries, CPV codes, buyer identifiers and award notices naming the winning supplier. Award notices (obvestilo o oddaji naročila) reveal which vendor now staffs a public financial body's payment/IT function — a direct organisation-change signal and a competitor-tracking signal.

source_name: OPSI — Odprti podatki Slovenije: Evidenca javnih naročil / oddanih javnih naročil datasets
why_relevant: Machine-readable dumps of the procurement record — notices, awards and award decisions — which make longitudinal tracking of a buyer's spend on payment/IT services (and therefore of insourcing vs outsourcing of staff) cheap and reliable, without scraping the HTML portal.

source_name: STATIST — public procurement statistics application (OPSI)
why_relevant: Aggregated view of Slovenian procurement since 2013 by buyer, procedure type and supplier. Useful for baselining a state financial body's normal spend pattern so that an unusual staff-augmentation or payment-services tender stands out as a reorganisation signal rather than routine renewal.

source_name: UJP — Uprava RS za javna plačila, javne objave / delovna mesta
why_relevant: UJP is the state payments administration; it is legally required to publish javni natečaj vacancy notices and selection outcomes here. Observed example: a public call for a PODSEKRETAR post for information security (DM 5201), naming the organisational unit and pay grade — direct evidence of headcount and internal structure in the state's payment infrastructure operator.

source_name: UJP JN Plačila portal (jnplacila.si) — reporting of payments under public contracts
why_relevant: UJP-operated portal where contracting authorities publish concluded public contracts and monthly reports on payments executed under them. Payment flows to a named IT/payments vendor over time are a proxy for how much of a public financial body's function is contracted out and when a contract is ramping up or being wound down.

source_name: GOV.SI 'Delovna mesta' job database (central state vacancy register, filter Tip objave = Javni natečaji)
why_relevant: Central aggregation of javni natečaj notices across all state administration bodies, filterable by organisation. Single crawl point covering UJP, FURS, Ministrstvo za finance and other state financial bodies at once, rather than polling each site.

source_name: eUprava — Javni natečaji uradniških delovnih mest (citizen portal life-event page)
why_relevant: Official explanation of where javni natečaj notices must be published and by whom, plus the entry point into the central vacancy database. Essential for building a legally-grounded crawl map of statutory vacancy publication for state financial bodies.

source_name: FURS — Finančna uprava RS, Zaposlitev / Delovna mesta objave
why_relevant: FURS is the largest state financial body (~3,600 staff) and publishes its javni natečaj notices and vacancy PDFs, including IT/informatika roles. Vacancy volume and role mix in its IT service is a leading indicator of tax/payment system modernisation programmes and of in-house vs contracted capacity.

source_name: SDH — Slovenski državni holding, aktualno/novice and nadzorni svet pages (governance appointments)
why_relevant: SDH manages the state's stakes in financial companies and publishes javni razpis calls for management-board members and the accreditation/nomination pipeline for supervisory-board members. These are the earliest formal signals of leadership change at state-influenced banks, insurers and financial entities.

source_name: SDH — Letno poročilo o upravljanju kapitalskih naložb RS in SDH (annual management report)
why_relevant: Annual reports document the kadrovska komisija's activity and board changes across state-held financial companies, giving a consolidated retrospective of leadership moves and governance reorganisations that scattered news items miss. Also anchors the actor map of state-owned financial entities.

source_name: Ministrstvo za finance — kadrovski razpisi / poziv za nadzornike SDH
why_relevant: The Ministry of Finance runs the public call (poziv) for SDH supervisory board candidates and publishes javni natečaj notices for its own posts, including IT/payments-adjacent roles. It is the upstream trigger for the whole state-financial governance chain (minister -> government -> National Assembly appointment).

source_name: SID banka — Javna naročila and Prosta delovna mesta / Informacije javnega značaja
why_relevant: State-owned promotional/development bank; a ZJN-3 contracting authority that also publishes its own vacancies and 'informacije javnega značaja' including information about concluded deals. Combines the procurement signal and the hiring signal for a state financial institution in one actor.

source_name: Kapitalska družba (KAD) — javni razpisi / javna naročila
why_relevant: State pension-fund manager and parent of Modra zavarovalnica; a contracting authority whose IT and financial-services tenders reveal system replacements and staffing arrangements inside a state financial entity. Its site states procurements are published on the national portal, so it also acts as a pointer.

source_name: Državna revizijska komisija (DKOM) — odločitve / iskalnik po odločitvah
why_relevant: Review decisions on contested public procurements expose, in unusual detail, the technical requirements, staffing/personnel-reference criteria and bidder identities of banking/payment/IT tenders — including specifics that the published notice summarises away. Also flags tenders that were annulled, i.e. plans that did not proceed on schedule.

source_name: ERAR (KPK) — public-sector transaction transparency application
source_subtype: anti-corruption transparency application over public payments
why_relevant: Shows actual transactions of public institutions and state/municipality-owned companies for goods, services and salaries. Following the money from UJP/FURS/SID to named payments and IT vendors reveals contracted headcount and outsourcing relationships that never appear as a vacancy, and dates when engagements start or stop.

source_name: Računsko sodišče RS — audit reports on state financial bodies
why_relevant: The Court of Audit audits UJP, FURS, the Ministry of Finance and state-owned financial entities; its reports describe organisational structure, staffing shortfalls, IT project failures and procurement irregularities in far more depth than any notice. It also publishes its own javni natečaj vacancies, confirming the statutory pattern.
